facts.text: Teaches dancing and performs in community theater productions through The Arts Program of NNY

Was key personnel as Assistant Professor on Seton Hall University's five-year, over-$1.2 million U.S. Department of Education "Project Write to Learn" grant to prepare occupational therapists and speech-language pathologists to improve written expression in children with specific learning disabilities; Clarkson lists the award as $1,230,342, 2017-2022
Named to SUNY Canton's President's List for Fall 2022 as a Bachelor of Science in Nursing student
Named to SUNY Canton's President's List for Spring 2023 as a Bachelor of Science in Nursing student
Played Crutchie in Disney's NEWSIES at the Axelrod Performing Arts Center, June 1-17, 2018, born with arthrogryposis and reported as the first actor with a disability to play the role

Starred as Quasimodo in "The Hunchback of Notre Dame" with the New Paradigm Theatre Company, as a Summer Youth Musical Theater Workshop alumnus whose first musical was "Titanic" at age 15, and was a full-time working actor based in the New York City area in 2018
First author of "Impact of targeted interventions on success of high-risk engineering students: a focus on historically underrepresented students in STEM," published in Frontiers in Education in 2025
Set to graduate cum laude from SUNY Potsdam with a Bachelor of Science degree in Public Health
Named to SUNY Potsdam President's List for Spring 2023
Completed The Dawson Academy's extensive continuing education courses
Active member of the American Dental Association, the Rhode Island Dental Association, and The Dawson Alumni Association
